create_PauseFailControl: create a PauseFailControl instance to pause or fail code under test control
use_PauseFailControl_pause: use PauseFailControl pause context manager to temporarily block code under test
use_PauseFailControl_fail: use PauseFailControl fail context manager to raise a Defect in code under test
call_PauseFailControl_control: call PauseFailControl control method from a system under test to check for pause or fail signals
use_Defect_exception: use the Defect exception to simulate a programming defect in a system under test
